Container.Name: psono
Container.Overview:
Psono server: the backend of the self-hosted Psono password manager for teams. Official image psono/psono-server. The Psono browser extensions, apps and web client connect to it. This container has no web UI of its own: the WebUI button opens /info/, which shows the server version when it runs.
Before the first start: a PostgreSQL database and settings.yaml in the config folder (appdata/psono/settings.yaml). The README has the steps. Database migrations run automatically at every start. For real use, put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: password manager vault team bitwarden vaultwarden
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL database and settings.yaml in the config folder before the first start (see the README).
